note: The only failing gate is the 0.1 end-to-end real-time-factor floor. It is a coarse alarm inherited from the earlier CI flag and was not derived from a measurement. Everything else is reported, not gated. Reference values were measured on Docker Desktop on ARM64 (two workers, two CPUs and 1536 MiB each), not on GitHub-hosted runners. Nothing yet compares one nightly run with another; each report lives only as long as its workflow artifact is retained.

median_end_to_end_real_time_factor.source: Floor: coarse alarm carried over from the earlier `check_replay.py --minimum-real-time-factor 0.1` CI flag (docs/releases.md); not derived from a measurement. Reference: docs/phase-3-verification.md frozen replay pilot, median 0.420x across 18 valid episodes (range 0.214x to 0.477x).

median_mission_real_time_factor.source: Reported only. Objective: Phase 2 5x speed target, tracked separately per design decision 5. Reference: docs/adr/0004-replay-timing.md reference mission at 0.66x.

infrastructure_attempt_rate.source: Reported only, not gated. Reference: docs/phase-3-verification.md, 1 infrastructure attempt across 19 pilot attempts (18 valid episodes).

episodes_per_minute.source: Reported only. No documented measurement; computed from the nightly campaign step's wall time.

diagnostic_replay_agreement.source: Reported only. Agreement of tonight's diagnostic pilot corpus (fresh regressions, 3 replays each), a different population from the frozen fixtures gated by docker/check_replay.py. Objective: Phase 2 95% agreement target. No reference: the documented 0 of 17 figure was measured on the original Phase 2 representatives, not on this corpus.
